# Byterygon UI registry

> Base UI components styled with Byterygon design-token roles, as a static shadcn registry. No network: install from this folder or from a static server you host.

Install (components.json: "registries": { "@byterygon": "<this folder or URL>/{name}.json" }, "tailwind": { "baseColor": "" }):

    shadcn add <this folder>/theme-default.json @byterygon/button

## Themes

- [theme-default](theme-default.json): The Byterygon default theme: a blue-teal brand on a neutral tinted with the same hue, light by default, comfortable density, WCAG 2.2 AA.
- [theme-high-contrast](theme-high-contrast.json): High contrast: WCAG 2.2 AAA (7:1 text, 4.5:1 for controls and focus), pure grey neutral, a deep blue accent and a thick focus ring. Comfortable density.
- [theme-midnight](theme-midnight.json): Midnight: dark first, on a deep blue neutral with a periwinkle accent. The light scheme is a cool blue-tinted counterpart. Comfortable density.
- [theme-paper](theme-paper.json): Paper: a warm light theme for reading. Cream backgrounds, a rust accent, larger text with relaxed line height, rounder corners, comfortable density.
- [theme-slate](theme-slate.json): Slate: near-greyscale and minimal. A muted slate-blue accent on a barely tinted neutral, square-ish corners, light by default, comfortable density.
- [theme-terminal](theme-terminal.json): Terminal: dark first, a green accent on a green-black neutral, monospace for all interface text, 13 px text, square corners, compact density.

## Components

### Button

[button.json](button.json): An action button: primary, secondary, ghost and danger variants in three density-aware sizes, with disabled and loading states.

Usage: Use one primary Button per view for the main action, secondary next to it, ghost in toolbars and dense rows, danger for destructive actions. Give it a visible text label; for an icon alone use IconButton. Set loading while the action runs instead of disabling it, and type="submit" inside a form.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/button
- variant: primary, secondary, ghost, danger
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: variant ("primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger", default "primary"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); loading (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); type ("button" | "submit" | "reset", default "button"); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled), loading (data-loading)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.fg.default, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.solid, color.status.danger.solid-fg, color.status.danger.solid-hover, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it. An icon-only button needs aria-label. Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable (aria-disabled) so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy. The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only (focus-visible) and meets 3:1 against every surface (token pair color.ring). Text and background pairs of every variant are contrast-checked by the token build in light and dark.

### Checkbox

[checkbox.json](checkbox.json): A checkbox on Base UI's Checkbox, ticked, unticked or mixed, in three sizes, with CheckboxGroup for several checkboxes sharing one value and a parent "select all".

Usage: Use Checkbox for a yes/no choice that is applied when the form is submitted ("Include column headers"), and CheckboxGroup for picking any number of options from a short list. Wrap each checkbox and its text in a FieldLabel inside a Field; in a group, put a FieldLegend first and each option in a FieldItem. With TanStack Form wire checked, onCheckedChange and onBlur (or the group's value and onValueChange) to the field. For a setting that takes effect at once use Switch; for one choice out of several, RadioGroup; for a long list, a MultiSelect.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/checkbox
- Parts: CheckboxGroup (data-slot checkbox-group): Checkboxes sharing one string[] value, a column with gap space.stack.sm; a fieldset named by its FieldLegend.
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: checked (boolean); defaultChecked (boolean, default false); onCheckedChange ((checked: boolean, details) => void); indeterminate (boolean, default false); value (string); parent (boolean, default false); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLSpanElement>)
- States: hover (hover), checked (data-checked), indeterminate (data-indeterminate), focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.xs, ring.offset, ring.width, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xs, space.stack.sm
- Accessibility: Renders a <span role="checkbox"> with aria-checked (true, false or mixed) and a hidden native input for forms; Tab reaches it and Space toggles it. Label it by wrapping it in a FieldLabel with its text; the text then toggles it too and enlarges the target beyond the 14 to 20 px box (WCAG 2.2 target size). A group is a fieldset named by its FieldLegend; a FieldDescription inside a FieldItem describes that option only. Ticked and mixed are shown by a check or a dash as well as the accent fill; the unticked border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface). Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### Combobox

[combobox.json](combobox.json): One choice from a long list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox: an input in an Input-like frame with clear and open buttons, and a popup of filtered items, groups, a no-results line and a status line, in three sizes.

Usage: Use Combobox when the user picks one value from a list too long to scan (tables, roles, time zones) or knows what to type. Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items (strings, { value, label } objects, groups of { value, items }, or a Combobox.createItems collection to store ids) and a function child that renders each item as a ComboboxItem; Base UI filters by label as the user types and the first match is highlighted, so Enter takes it. Show loading or an error of an async search with status, and say what was searched for with emptyMessage. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field. For a short fixed list use Select; for several values, MultiSelect; for free text with suggestions, an Input.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/combobox
- Parts: ComboboxItem (data-slot combobox-item): One item, role="option": its content, and a check mark while chosen; color.interactive.hover while highlighted.; ComboboxGroup (data-slot combobox-group): A group of items, role="group", named by its ComboboxGroupLabel; render its items in a ComboboxCollection.; ComboboxGroupLabel (data-slot combobox-group-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; ComboboxSeparator (data-slot combobox-separator): A 1 px line in color.border.default between items or groups.
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: items (Item[] | { value, items: Item[] }[] | ComboboxItemCollection); value (Value | null); defaultValue (Value | null); onValueChange ((value: Value | null, details) => void); inputValue (string); filter ((item, query) => boolean | null); placeholder (string); emptyMessage (ReactNode, default "\"No results.\""); status (ReactNode); autoHighlight (boolean, default true); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); clearLabel (string, default "\"Clear\""); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (has-[input:focus-visible]), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), hover (hover), highlighted (data-highlighted), no value (not-data-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.focus, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, z.dropdown
- Accessibility: The input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", aria-expanded and aria-controls, named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" of role="option" items with aria-selected, in role="group"s named by their labels. Typing filters and opens the list; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight while focus stays in the input (aria-activedescendant), Enter chooses, Escape closes and then clears, and Tab leaves. The chevron button is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology, as the input already opens the list; the clear button is reachable by pointer and is named by clearLabel. The status line is aria-live="polite", so loading and errors of an async search are announced without moving focus; the no-results line is announced the same way. The chosen item shows a check mark, so the state does not rest on colour; the frame border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface). The popup takes the frame's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>.

### Field

[field.json](field.json): A form field on Base UI's Field parts: label, control, description and error tied together, with invalid, touched, dirty and disabled state taken from TanStack Form or set by hand.

Usage: Wrap every form control (Input, Textarea, InputGroup) in a Field with a FieldLabel; add FieldDescription for a hint and FieldError for the message. A Checkbox or Switch goes inside its FieldLabel, next to the text. A group of options (RadioGroup, CheckboxGroup) is one Field: a FieldLegend first inside the group, then a FieldItem per option with its FieldLabel and, if needed, its own FieldDescription. Group related Fields under a heading with FieldSet and FieldLegend. With TanStack Form, render it from form.Field and pass the field: <form.Field name="host">{(field) => <Field field={field}>…</Field>}</form.Field>, and wire the control's value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field. Without a form library, set invalid and FieldError's children yourself, or use Base UI's validate prop. Put the fields in a Form.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/field
- Parts: FieldLabel (data-slot field-label): The visible label, tied to the control; an inline row with gap space.inline.sm, so it can wrap a Checkbox, Radio or Switch and its text; danger-coloured while invalid, dimmed while disabled.; FieldDescription (data-slot field-description): A hint under the control, in color.fg.muted, named by aria-describedby.; FieldError (data-slot field-error): The validation message in color.status.danger.fg: its children, its errors prop, or the TanStack field's errors one per line.; FieldItem (data-slot field-item): One option of a RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup: its FieldLabel and FieldDescription in a column with gap space.stack.xs; disabled disables that option.; FieldSet (data-slot field-set): A <fieldset> grouping related Fields under a FieldLegend, a column with gap space.stack.md; disabled disables every control inside.; FieldLegend (data-slot field-legend): The name of a FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup, placed first inside it, in text.label; the group's aria-labelledby points to it.
- Props: field (FieldState (a TanStack Form field: name and state.meta)); name (string); invalid (boolean); touched (boolean); dirty (boolean); disabled (boolean, default false); validate ((value, formValues) => string | string[] | null | Promise<…>); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.status.danger.fg, font.sans, opacity.disabled, space.inline.sm, space.stack.md, space.stack.xs, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: FieldLabel is a <label> tied to the control, so clicking it focuses the control and screen readers announce it as the control's name. FieldDescription and FieldError are named in the control's aria-describedby; the error is read when the control is focused. A FieldSet, RadioGroup or CheckboxGroup is named by its FieldLegend through aria-labelledby; a FieldDescription inside a FieldItem describes that option only. An invalid field sets aria-invalid on the control; the message, not the danger colour, carries the meaning. Show errors after the user leaves the field or submits (the default with a TanStack field: touched and invalid), not on the first keystroke. color.status.danger.fg and color.fg.muted are contrast-checked as text on every surface.

### FileInput

[file-input.json](file-input.json): A file picker on a native <input type="file"> (Base UI's Input), as one line like an Input or as a dashed dropzone, with a Clear button and accept filtering of dropped files.

Usage: Use FileInput to pick local files the app reads in the browser or sends with the form: a CA certificate, a key, SQL scripts to import. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; set accept (".pem,.crt", "image/*") and multiple as on the native input. Read the files from onFilesChange ([] when cleared); with TanStack Form, keep File[] in the field and call field.handleChange from onFilesChange. The dropzone variant also takes dropped files (filtered by accept) and suits imports; the field variant suits settings forms. Nothing is uploaded by the component; it has no network code.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- variant: field, dropzone
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: onFilesChange ((files: File[]) => void); accept (string); multiple (boolean, default false); variant ("field" | "dropzone", default "field"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); chooseLabel (string, default "Choose file"); emptyLabel (string, default "No file chosen"); dropLabel (string, default "Drop a file here, or"); clearLabel (string, default "Clear file"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: hover (hover), focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input]:focus-visible]), dragging (data-dragging), empty (data-empty), invalid (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input][data-invalid]]), disabled (has-[[data-slot=file-input-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.subtle-bg, color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.subtle-bg, color.neutral.subtle-fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, space.stack.sm, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: The control is a native <input type="file">, visually hidden but focusable: Tab reaches it, Space or Enter opens the system picker, and screen readers announce its label and the chosen file. The chip and the file names repeat what the input announces, so they are aria-hidden; the FieldLabel names the input and clicking it opens the picker. Dropping files is a pointer shortcut only; the same files can always be chosen with the keyboard. Announce what was added in a role="status" element. The Clear button is named "Clear file" and returns focus to the input. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame (3:1 on every surface).

### Form

[form.json](form.json): A <form> laid out as a column of Fields and submitted through TanStack Form: no native validation, handleSubmit on submit, focus on the first invalid field.

Usage: Create the form with useForm from @tanstack/react-form (defaultValues, validators, onSubmit), pass it as form, and render each field with form.Field and a Field inside. For a native-like flow use validationLogic: revalidateLogic({ mode: "submit", modeAfterSubmission: "change" }); for per-field checks use validators.onBlur. Show the submit state with form.Subscribe and Button's loading. Without form, Form is only a styled <form>.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Props: form (AnyFormApi (from useForm)); noValidate (boolean); onSubmit ((event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => void); aria-label (string); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLFormElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: space.stack.md
- Accessibility: Renders a native <form>, so Enter in a text field submits it; keep a type="submit" Button in it. After a failed submit, focus moves to the first invalid control in document order, and its FieldError is read through aria-describedby. Name the form with aria-label or aria-labelledby when the page has more than one. Errors appear on submit and then follow each change (revalidateLogic) or on blur, never on the first keystroke of an untouched field. Announce the outcome of a submission in a role="status" region; the submit Button's loading sets aria-busy.

### IconButton

[icon-button.json](icon-button.json): A square, icon-only action button with Button's four variants in three density-aware sizes, disabled and loading states, and a required aria-label.

Usage: Use IconButton where a familiar icon says enough and space is tight: toolbars, table rows, inside an InputGroup. Put an <svg aria-hidden> inside and describe the action in aria-label ("Copy connection string", not "Copy icon"); the type requires it. Ghost is the default; use primary for the one main action of a toolbar. When the icon is not obvious, use a Button with text instead.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/button
- variant: primary, secondary, ghost, danger
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: aria-label (string); variant ("primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger", default "ghost"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); loading (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); type ("button" | "submit" | "reset", default "button"); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled), loading (data-loading)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-active, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.fg.default, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.neutral.bg, color.neutral.bg-active, color.neutral.bg-hover, color.neutral.fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.solid, color.status.danger.solid-fg, color.status.danger.solid-hover, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, space.inline.sm
- Accessibility: Renders a native <button> with type="button" unless type is set, so Enter and Space activate it. aria-label is required by the type and names the action; mark the icon aria-hidden so it is not read twice. Disabled uses the native disabled attribute; loading keeps the button focusable so focus is not lost mid-action, and sets aria-busy. The smallest size (size.control.sm, 22 px in compact) passes WCAG 2.2 target size (minimum 24 px) only with spacing around it; keep IconButtons at least gap-inline-xs apart, or use md in dense toolbars. The focus ring shows for keyboard focus only and meets 3:1 against every surface; every variant's colours are contrast-checked by the token build.

### Input

[input.json](input.json): A single-line text input in three density-aware sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Base UI Field.

Usage: Put Input inside a Field with a FieldLabel (and FieldDescription and FieldError as needed); it takes the label, description and validity from it. Use Textarea for multi-line text and InputGroup for an icon, a unit or a button attached to the input. Match the size to the controls beside it.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); value (string); defaultValue (string); onValueChange ((value: string, details) => void); disabled (boolean, default false); aria-invalid (boolean | "true" | "false"); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (aria-invalid), invalid-in-field (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.subtle, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, space.control.x, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight
- Accessibility: Renders a native <input>; give it a visible <label> (or a Base UI Field.Label), or aria-label when there is no room for one. Placeholder text is a hint, not a label; it uses color.fg.subtle, contrast-checked on every surface. Mark errors with aria-invalid and point aria-describedby at the message; the danger border is not the only signal. The border (color.border.strong) meets 3:1 against every surface, as WCAG 1.4.11 asks of a control's outline. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

### InputGroup

[input-group.json](input-group.json): A text input with prefixes and suffixes attached (icons, text such as a scheme or a unit, ghost buttons), in one frame that shows focus, invalid and disabled; works inside a Field.

Usage: Use InputGroup when something belongs to the input: a search icon, a fixed prefix (postgres://), a unit (ms), or an action on the value (Copy, Test, Show). Put InputGroupAddon and InputGroupButton before or after InputGroupInput in the order they should appear, and wrap the group in a Field for its label and error. For an unrelated action next to an input, use a plain Input and a Button side by side.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- Parts: InputGroupInput (data-slot input-group-input): The text control (Base UI's Input): takes a Field's label and validity; its value, onValueChange and onBlur as Input's.; InputGroupAddon (data-slot input-group-addon): An icon or text in color.fg.muted; clicking it focuses the control.; InputGroupButton (data-slot input-group-button): A Button (ghost by default) one size smaller than the group, inset from the frame; Button's props.
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input]:focus-visible]), invalid (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][aria-invalid=true]]), invalid-in-field (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-invalid]]), disabled (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: The control is a native <input>; give it a FieldLabel through a Field, or aria-label. Addon text is not part of its name: say in the label or description what a prefix means. Mark decorative addon icons aria-hidden; an icon-only InputGroupButton needs aria-label. Tab moves from the control to the button; the frame's ring follows the control, the button has its own focus ring. Clicking an addon focuses the control, so the whole frame is a click target. The frame border (color.border.strong) meets 3:1 against every surface; invalid uses color.status.danger.border and FieldError's message, not colour alone.

### Kbd

[kbd.json](kbd.json): A keyboard key or shortcut shown as text: a <kbd> in the code type role on an inset background, with KbdGroup for combinations.

Usage: Use Kbd in help text, menus and tooltips to show a key (Esc) or, with KbdGroup, a shortcut (Ctrl + K). Write the separator between the keys as text (+, then). Kbd shows a shortcut; it does not bind one. For a symbol (⌘, ⇧) add hidden text that names the key.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/use-render
- Parts: KbdGroup (data-slot kbd-group): Lines up the keys of one shortcut with their text separators, in text.caption and color.fg.muted.
- Props: children (ReactNode); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLElement>)
- States: 
- Tokens: color.bg.inset, color.border.default, color.fg.muted, font.mono, font.sans, radius.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.xs, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, text.code.leading, text.code.size, text.code.tracking, text.code.weight
- Accessibility: Renders <kbd>, which marks keyboard input; KbdGroup is an outer <kbd>, as HTML nests the keys of a combination. Screen readers read the key labels and the text separators; write "Ctrl", not an icon alone. A <kbd> takes no aria-label: give a symbol (⌘) visually hidden text (sr-only) and mark the symbol aria-hidden. Not focusable and not interactive; nothing to operate. color.fg.muted on color.bg.inset is contrast-checked as text by the token build.

### MultiSelect

[multi-select.json](multi-select.json): Several choices from a list, typed to filter, on Base UI's Combobox with multiple: each chosen item is a removable chip before the input, with Combobox's popup and items, in three sizes.

Usage: Use MultiSelect when the user picks any number of values from a list (columns, privileges, schemas, tags). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items and a function child that renders each one as a ComboboxItem, as for Combobox; value is an array. Items that are { value, label } objects show their label on the chip; for ids from a Combobox.createItems collection pass itemToStringLabel. The list stays open after each choice; Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field. For one value use Combobox or Select; for a few always-visible options, a CheckboxGroup.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/combobox
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: items (Item[] | { value, items: Item[] }[] | ComboboxItemCollection); value (Value[]); defaultValue (Value[]); onValueChange ((value: Value[], details) => void); itemToStringLabel ((value: Value) => string); placeholder (string); emptyMessage (ReactNode, default "\"No results.\""); status (ReactNode); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); clearLabel (string, default "\"Clear all\""); removeLabel ((label: string) => string, default "label => `Remove ${label}`"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: focus-visible (has-[input:focus-visible]), has values (has-[[data-slot=multi-select-chip]]), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), hover (hover), chip highlighted (data-highlighted), no value (not-data-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.focus, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.neutral.subtle-bg, color.neutral.subtle-fg, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xs, space.control.x, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight, z.dropdown
- Accessibility: The input is role="combobox" with aria-autocomplete="list", named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" with aria-multiselectable, and chosen items have aria-selected and a check mark. Typing filters; ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the highlight, Enter adds or removes the highlighted item and the list stays open. Backspace in the empty input removes the last chip; ArrowLeft at the start of the input moves onto the chips, where Backspace or Delete removes one. Each chip is named by its text and its remove button by removeLabel ("Remove SELECT"); the clear button is named by clearLabel. The chevron is out of the tab order and hidden from assistive technology. Chips use color.neutral.subtle with color.neutral.subtle-fg (4.5:1), and the highlighted chip color.interactive.selected, with a focus ring as well. The popup takes the frame's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>.

### NumberInput

[number-input.json](number-input.json): A number input on Base UI's NumberField with decrement and increment buttons, bounds, steps, locale formatting, and three density-aware sizes.

Usage: Use NumberInput for a number the user types or nudges: a port, a pool size, a timeout. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; with TanStack Form wire value (a number, or null when empty), onValueChange and onBlur to the field. Set min, max and step, and format (Intl.NumberFormat options) for units or percentages; the value stays a plain number. Arrow keys step, Shift+arrow or PageUp/PageDown take largeStep. For a value in a range where the exact number matters less, use Slider; for identifiers that only look like numbers (an account number, a ZIP code), use Input.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/number-field
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: value (number | null); defaultValue (number); onValueChange ((value: number | null, details) => void); onValueCommitted ((value: number | null, details) => void); min (number); max (number); step (number, default 1); largeStep (number, default 10); format (Intl.NumberFormatOptions); locale (Intl.LocalesArgument); allowOutOfRange (boolean, default false); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); placeholder (string); decrementLabel (string, default "Decrease"); incrementLabel (string, default "Increase"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); inputRef (Ref<HTMLInputElement>); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=number-input-input]:focus-visible]), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled), at-limit (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight
- Accessibility: The text control is an <input> with inputmode="decimal" (Base UI); inside a Field it takes the label, description and aria-invalid. Without a Field, give it an aria-label. Arrow Up and Down change the value by step, Shift+arrow and PageUp/PageDown by largeStep, Home and End jump to min and max. The step buttons are named Decrease and Increase and stay out of the tab order (the keyboard already steps); they disable at the limits. A formatted value ("30 seconds") is read as shown; the form submits the plain number. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### PasswordInput

[password-input.json](password-input.json): A password input with a show/hide button, on InputGroup and Base UI's Input, in three density-aware sizes.

Usage: Use PasswordInput for any secret the user types: a database password, a key passphrase, a token. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; with TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field like Input. Set autoComplete="new-password" when the user chooses a new secret (the default, "current-password", lets password managers fill a saved one). The show button keeps the name "Show password" (toggleLabel) in both states. For a secret the user should not see at all, use a disabled PasswordInput or no input.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: value (string); defaultValue (string); onValueChange ((value: string, details) => void); visible (boolean); defaultVisible (boolean, default false); onVisibleChange ((visible: boolean) => void); toggleLabel (string, default "Show password"); autoComplete (string, default "current-password"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); disabled (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: hover (hover), visible (aria-pressed), focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-invalid]]), disabled (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: The text control is a native <input type="password"> (type="text" while shown), so password managers, paste and autofill work. The show button is a native <button> after the input in tab order, named "Show password" in both states and with aria-pressed telling whether the text is shown. Showing the text keeps focus where it was; the value and the caret do not change. Inside a Field the input takes the label, description and aria-invalid. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### RadioGroup

[radio-group.json](radio-group.json): One choice out of several, on Base UI's RadioGroup and Radio: a fieldset of radios named by a FieldLegend, each option in a FieldItem with its own label and description, in three sizes.

Usage: Use RadioGroup when the user must pick exactly one of two to about six options and should see them all at once (TLS mode, line endings). Put it in a Field, a FieldLegend first, then a FieldItem per option with a FieldLabel around a RadioGroupItem and its text, and a FieldDescription when the option needs explaining. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field; an empty value means nothing is chosen yet. For more options use Select; for a choice that applies at once in a toolbar, ToggleGroup; for yes/no, Checkbox or Switch.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/radio-group
- Parts: RadioGroupItem (data-slot radio-group-item): One radio, a circle with color.border.strong that fills with the accent solid and a dot in color.accent.fg when chosen.
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: value (string); defaultValue (string); onValueChange ((value: string, details) => void); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: hover (hover), checked (data-checked), focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-hover, color.accent.fg, color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, ring.offset, ring.width, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, space.stack.sm
- Accessibility: Renders a <div role="radiogroup"> named by its FieldLegend (aria-labelledby), with a <span role="radio"> and aria-checked per option, and hidden native inputs for forms. Tab enters the group at the chosen radio (or the first) and leaves it; arrow keys move the choice, skipping disabled radios. Wrap each radio and its text in a FieldLabel: the text chooses it too, which enlarges the target beyond the 14 to 20 px circle (WCAG 2.2 target size). A FieldDescription inside the FieldItem describes that option only. The chosen radio shows a dot as well as the accent fill; the border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface). Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### SearchInput

[search-input.json](search-input.json): A search box on InputGroup and Base UI's Input: a search icon, type="search", and a Clear button (and Escape) while there is text, in three density-aware sizes.

Usage: Use SearchInput to filter or search a list as the user types: tables in a schema browser, rows of a result, settings. Name it with a FieldLabel or an aria-label ("Search tables"); the placeholder is not a name. Wire value and onValueChange (called with "" when cleared) and announce the result count in a role="status" element. Escape clears the text, and only passes through when there is nothing to clear. For a query that runs on Enter only, use it the same way and act in onKeyDown; for picking one option from a list, use Combobox.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: value (string); defaultValue (string, default ""); onValueChange ((value: string) => void); clearLabel (string, default "Clear search"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); placeholder (string); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLInputElement>)
- States: hover (hover), focus-visible (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input]:focus-visible]), invalid (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-invalid]]), disabled (has-[[data-slot=input-group-input][data-disabled]])
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: The text control is a native <input type="search"> (role searchbox); name it with a FieldLabel or aria-label, not only a placeholder. The Clear button is a native <button> named "Clear search"; it returns focus to the input. Escape clears as well, and is left to the page (a dialog) when the box is empty. Announce how many results match in a role="status" element next to it; the box itself does not. The search icon is decorative (aria-hidden) and clicking it focuses the input. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### Select

[select.json](select.json): One choice from a list, on Base UI's Select: a trigger that looks like an Input and shows the chosen label, and a listbox popup with items, groups and separators, in three sizes.

Usage: Use Select when the user picks one value from a fixed list of about five to thirty options they need not type (SSL mode, engine, isolation level). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel, pass items (a record of value to label, or { value, label } objects) so the trigger shows the label before the popup opens, and list the options as SelectItem children, grouped with SelectGroup and SelectGroupLabel when that helps. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onOpenChange (blur on close) to the field; null means nothing is chosen. For two to six options that should all be visible use RadioGroup; for long or searchable lists, Combobox; for several values, MultiSelect.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/select
- Parts: SelectItem (data-slot select-item): One option, role="option": its text, and a check mark while chosen; color.interactive.hover while highlighted.; SelectGroup (data-slot select-group): A group of options, role="group", named by its SelectGroupLabel.; SelectGroupLabel (data-slot select-group-label): A group's heading in type.caption and color.fg.subtle.; SelectSeparator (data-slot select-separator): A 1 px line in color.border.default between options or groups.
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: items (Record<string, ReactNode> | { value, label }[]); value (Value | null); defaultValue (Value | null); onValueChange ((value: Value | null, details) => void); placeholder (ReactNode); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); open (boolean); name (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), open (data-popup-open), entering (data-starting-style), placeholder (data-placeholder), highlighted (data-highlighted), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.overlay, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.focus, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.disabled, color.fg.muted, color.fg.subtle, color.interactive.hover, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, elevation.overlay.shadow, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.enter, motion.easing.exit, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, radius.sm, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.control.xs, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, space.inset.xs, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight, text.caption.leading, text.caption.size, text.caption.tracking, text.caption.weight, z.dropdown
- Accessibility: The trigger is a <button role="combobox"> with aria-haspopup="listbox" and aria-expanded, named by its FieldLabel (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; the popup is a role="listbox" of role="option" items with aria-selected. Enter, Space, ArrowDown and ArrowUp open the popup; arrow keys, Home and End move the highlight, typing jumps to the option that starts with the text, Enter chooses and Escape closes, and focus returns to the trigger. Disabled options are skipped by the keyboard and shown in color.fg.disabled; a group's label names the group (aria-labelledby). The chosen option shows a check mark as well as its place in the trigger, so the state does not rest on colour; the trigger border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface). The popup takes the trigger's theme and density even when they are set on a region rather than <html>, so its contrast matches the page it opened from.

### Slider

[slider.json](slider.json): A slider on Base UI's Slider: one value or a range with two thumbs, horizontal or vertical, on a size.track track with an accent indicator, in three thumb sizes.

Usage: Use Slider for a value in a known range where the position matters more than the exact number (a sample percentage, a zoom level), or for a range with two thumbs. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel, and show the current value in the label or next to it; name each thumb of a range with getAriaLabel. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur (onValueCommitted for work that should run only when the user lets go). For an exact number, use NumberInput, or pair the two.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/slider
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: value (number | number[]); defaultValue (number | number[]); onValueChange ((value: number | number[], details) => void); onValueCommitted ((value: number | number[], details) => void); min (number, default 0); max (number, default 100); step (number, default 1); largeStep (number, default 10); minStepsBetweenValues (number, default 0); orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); aria-label (string); getAriaLabel ((index: number) => string); format (Intl.NumberFormatOptions); name (string); disabled (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: hover (hover), dragging (data-dragging), focus-visible (has-[:focus-visible]), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.strong, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, ring.offset, ring.width, shadow.raised, size.control.xs, size.icon.lg, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.track
- Accessibility: Each thumb holds a native <input type="range">, so screen readers announce it as a slider with its value, and Tab reaches each thumb. Arrow keys move by step, PageUp/PageDown and Shift+arrow by largeStep, Home and End to min and max. A FieldLabel names a single thumb; name both thumbs of a range with getAriaLabel ("Minimum length", "Maximum length"). Use format so units are announced. The thumb has a color.border.strong border (3:1 against the surface and the track); the selected part is the accent solid. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the thumb (3:1 on every surface).

### Switch

[switch.json](switch.json): An on/off switch on Base UI's Switch: a track that fills with the accent solid and a sliding thumb, in three sizes.

Usage: Use Switch for a setting that takes effect as soon as it is flipped ("Auto-commit", "Read-only connection"), in settings panels and side panels. Wrap it in a FieldLabel with its text (the text may come first) inside a Field, and add a FieldDescription for what it does; group related switches in a FieldSet with a FieldLegend. With TanStack Form wire checked, onCheckedChange and onBlur to the field. For a choice that only applies when a form is submitted, use Checkbox; for a toolbar toggle, ToggleButton.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/switch
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: checked (boolean); defaultChecked (boolean, default false); onCheckedChange ((checked: boolean, details) => void); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); name (string); value (string); uncheckedValue (string); required (boolean, default false); disabled (boolean, default false); readOnly (boolean, default false); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLSpanElement>)
- States: hover (hover), checked (data-checked), focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.accent.bg, color.accent.bg-hover, color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, ring.offset, ring.width, shadow.raised, size.icon.md, size.icon.sm, size.icon.xs
- Accessibility: Renders a <span role="switch"> with aria-checked and a hidden native input for forms; Tab reaches it, Space and Enter flip it. Label it by wrapping it in a FieldLabel with its text; the text flips it too and enlarges the target beyond the track (WCAG 2.2 target size). Name the setting, not the state ("Auto-commit", not "Auto-commit on"). On and off differ by the thumb's position as well as the track colour; the off track is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface). The thumb slides in the reading direction (right in LTR, left in RTL). Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### Textarea

[textarea.json](textarea.json): A multi-line text input on Base UI's Input rendering a <textarea>, in Input's three sizes, with placeholder, invalid and disabled states; works inside a Field.

Usage: Use Textarea for text that may span lines (descriptions, notes, filters, short SQL); use Input for one line and the SQL editor for real queries. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; set rows to the expected length (3 by default). It resizes vertically; pass className="resize-none" to stop that.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/input
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); rows (number, default 3); value (string); defaultValue (string); onValueChange ((value: string, details) => void); disabled (boolean, default false); aria-invalid (boolean | "true" | "false"); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLTextAreaElement>)
- States: focus-visible (focus-visible), invalid (aria-invalid), invalid-in-field (data-invalid), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.subtle, color.ring, color.status.danger.border, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, space.control.x, space.inline.md, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body.leading, text.body.size, text.body.tracking, text.body.weight
- Accessibility: Renders a native <textarea>; give it a FieldLabel (or a <label>), or aria-label when there is no room for one. Enter inserts a line break and Tab leaves the field, as in any textarea; do not trap Tab. Placeholder text is a hint, not a label; it uses color.fg.subtle, contrast-checked on every surface. Mark errors with a Field (aria-invalid and aria-describedby follow) or aria-invalid; the danger border is not the only signal. The border (color.border.strong) meets 3:1 against every surface; focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

### ToggleButton

[toggle-button.json](toggle-button.json): A button that stays pressed or unpressed, on Base UI's Toggle, in a ghost or outline variant and three density-aware sizes.

Usage: Use ToggleButton for a setting that is on or off and takes effect at once, in a toolbar or next to what it changes: word wrap in an editor, "show nulls" over a grid. Give an icon-only toggle an aria-label naming the setting ("Word wrap"), not the action; the pressed state is announced. For one choice out of several, or several related toggles, use ToggleGroup; for a setting in a form, use Switch or Checkbox.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/toggle
- variant: ghost, outline
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: pressed (boolean); defaultPressed (boolean, default false); onPressedChange ((pressed: boolean, details) => void); variant ("ghost" | "outline", default "ghost"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); disabled (boolean, default false); aria-label (string); render (ReactElement | ((props, state) => ReactElement)); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLButtonElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), pressed (data-pressed), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.interactive.selected-hover, color.ring, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: Renders a native <button> with aria-pressed, so Enter and Space toggle it and screen readers announce "toggle button, pressed". Icon-only toggles need an aria-label naming the setting ("Word wrap"); keep the name the same in both states, the pressed state carries the change. Pressed is shown by color.interactive.selected and a change from color.fg.muted to color.fg.default, and announced by aria-pressed, not by colour alone. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

### ToggleGroup

[toggle-group.json](toggle-group.json): Toggle buttons with one shared value, on Base UI's ToggleGroup: a segmented outline track or quiet ghost items, single or multiple selection, horizontal or vertical, in three density-aware sizes.

Usage: Use ToggleGroup for a small set of options that apply at once and stay visible: the result view (grid, JSON, chart), cell alignment, which columns to show. Name the group with aria-label and give each ToggleGroupItem a value; without multiple, one item is pressed at a time (the user can release it, so check for an empty value), with multiple any number. Wire value and onValueChange for controlled state. Outline is a segmented control; ghost suits toolbars. For a choice inside a form that must have exactly one answer, use RadioGroup; for one on/off setting, ToggleButton or Switch.

- Wraps: @base-ui/react/toggle-group
- Parts: ToggleGroupItem (data-slot toggle-group-item): One toggle of the group, with ToggleButton's look; value identifies it, aria-label names an icon-only one.
- variant: outline, ghost
- size: sm, md, lg
- Props: value (string[]); defaultValue (string[]); onValueChange ((value: string[], details) => void); multiple (boolean, default false); orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical", default "horizontal"); variant ("outline" | "ghost", default "outline"); size ("sm" | "md" | "lg", default "md"); disabled (boolean, default false); loopFocus (boolean, default true); aria-label (string); className (string); ref (Ref<HTMLDivElement>)
- States: hover (hover), active (active), pressed (data-pressed), focus-visible (focus-visible), disabled (data-disabled)
- Tokens: color.bg.surface, color.border.default, color.border.strong, color.fg.default, color.fg.muted, color.interactive.active, color.interactive.hover, color.interactive.selected, color.interactive.selected-hover, color.ring, font.sans, motion.duration.fast, motion.easing.standard, opacity.disabled, radius.md, ring.offset, ring.width, size.control.lg, size.control.md, size.control.sm, size.icon.sm, space.control.x, space.inline.sm, space.inline.xs, space.inset.lg, space.inset.sm, text.body-strong.leading, text.body-strong.size, text.body-strong.tracking, text.body-strong.weight, text.label.leading, text.label.size, text.label.tracking, text.label.weight
- Accessibility: The group is a <div role="group">; name it with aria-label (or aria-labelledby). Each item is a native <button> with aria-pressed. Tab reaches the group once; arrow keys move between items (left and right, or up and down when vertical), Enter and Space press. Pressed is shown by color.interactive.selected and color.fg.default, and announced by aria-pressed, not by colour alone. Icon-only items need an aria-label each. Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).

## Helpers

- [cn.json](cn.json): class-name merging that knows the role names; every component depends on it.
- [theme-scope.json](theme-scope.json): gives popups in a portal the theme and density of their trigger; the popup components depend on it.
